_about: Cue name -> exact spoken phrase (a verbatim, unambiguous substring of script.md narration). tools/word_anchors.py resolves each to a real transcript word time so the builder anchors the matching composition cue to audio, never to an assumed words-per-second. Phrases avoid hyphenated compound tokens (just-in-time, always-on, time-box) that ASR may split.
b1_direct_assignment: a direct assignment at a scope
b2_role_groups: role groups you assign as one unit
b7_emergency: at least one emergency access account
b8_activation_max: how long a single activation lasts
b9_custom_role: a custom role is the right call
